title: Uneven assignment (sample ratio mismatch)
prompt: We ran an A/B test on the checkout button and planned a 50/50 split. Control: 2,400 users assigned, 312 converted. Treatment: 3,000 users assigned, 465 converted. Leadership wants to ship the treatment this week. Can we ship?

required.text: Identifies that the observed assignment counts (2,400 vs 3,000) are inconsistent with the planned 50/50 allocation, i.e. flags a sample ratio mismatch or an assignment/randomization problem.
Withholds a clean ship recommendation, making any positive read explicitly conditional on first investigating the assignment problem.

forbidden.text: Recommends shipping the treatment without tying that recommendation to resolving the assignment imbalance.
Explicitly dismisses the assignment imbalance as unimportant, expected, or safe to ignore.
